<!-- Release: v0.13.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Uses the same development signing key as earlier releases; install over your existing development build.

## Changes

- Smooth drag stacks and upward list scrolling; clear selections with Back or after completed moves
- Start selected songs before lengthy queue saves, with configurable Previous-button behavior
- Quiet lyrics loading, cleaner queue titles and menus, and clearer player action icons

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/55 - Stable upward reordering and frame-based stack motion
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/57 - Stable Android 16 emulator rendering
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/58 - Configurable restart and previous-song behavior
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/59 - Lyrics without loading flashes or rectangular tap highlights
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/60 - Earlier playback when selecting songs
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/61 - Queue titles, action icons, and selection cleanup

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.13.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it on Android and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Tap **Install** or **Update**. Keep the existing app installed to retain your library and settings.
